title: The Vault of Unspoken Nomenclature

features.name: the-unspoken-chorus
features.desc-on-touch: You hear the shape of words that have never been called aloud. Each one exists in the geometry of breath, waiting for a voice that will complete it.

features.name: the-potential-glyph-rows
features.desc-on-touch: Rows of symbols planted like seeds. Each one could be a name. None have sprouted into speech yet.

features.name: the-archive-that-swallows-its-own-utterance
features.desc-on-touch: A place where names arrive as soon as they are uttered, then withdraw into the vault, still unspoken.

features.name: the-silence-that-holds-everything
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of dark air where potential names rest, waiting for the tongue that will make them real.

features.name: the-nomenclature-plaque
features.desc-on-touch: An ANSI directory listing of names that exist only in potential. The filenames are written in a script that predates sound.

inscription: here dwell the beautiful names that silence has protected

file.name: Unspoken_Nomenclature_Registry.txt
file.note: A list of names in cipher, each one valid only if never pronounced. The file is a prayer in the form of an index.

exits.label: back upward to names becoming beautiful as they are spoken
a shaft of light where one name breaks the surface
deeper silence, where names become their own echo
downward to the bedrock where names were carved before language existed
